description: This file defines the interface CustomerOptionSetDao, which extends a generic DAO for CustomerOptionSet entities. It declares methods for retrieving CustomerOptionSet objects based on different criteria such as option ID, store, and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to CustomerOptionSet entities, extending a generic DAO interface.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet objects associated with a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOptionSet objects for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionSet object by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSet objects linked to a specific option value ID within a store.
